I can't compute this answer because the order data isn't in my working directory.

I checked `/tmp/r2run-fq7ybbbb`, which is my primary working directory. It contains only configuration files (`.claude/`, `.mcp.json`, `.gitconfig`, shell profiles, and similar) and no IURC orders, recommendation forms, or any dataset. It is also not a git repository, so there is no history to check.

The data is presumably in `/home/claude/projects/dig-risk-control`. That path is outside the directories I was given, and the sandbox denies reads to it, so I did not look there.

To get the answer, one of these would work:
- Put the order data (text, PDF, or extracted tables for the 2021 and 2025 orders) into this working directory, and I will parse the cites, respondents, and headline penalties and compute the two means.
- Or confirm that the dig-risk-control project is in scope for this task, so the sandbox can be configured to allow reading it.

Once I have the data, the computation is: for each year, select cases whose respondent is non-utility, take the headline penalty as defined (first printed "$" amount, with $0 when none), average over all such cases including the $0 ones, and round to the nearest dollar.

I have no estimate to offer, since I have no basis for one.
